{{Top}}
The '''Starfighter Corps''' was a military branch that conducted [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] operations in [[Realspace/Legends|outer space]] or a planet's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. A starfighter corps was typically an independent military service, however in some cases it was a joint activity between, or an integral component of, an [[Army/Legends|army]] or [[Navy/Legends|navy]].
